programmes.d: The Battle City Tournament begins; Yugi challenges the Rare Hunter to win back Joey's Red-Eyes Black Dragon.

Yugi figures out the Rare Hunter's strategy to summon the almighty Exodia, but it's too late to stop him; the Rare Hunter already has four pieces of Exodia in his hand and the fifth and final piece is on top of his deck.
Joey challenges a duelist with psychic powers.
At the hospital, Tristan tells Serenity that Joey is winning the duel.
Yugi faces Pandora in a dueling arena where their legs are shackled to the floor.
Yugi and his friends play a card-battling game called Duel Monsters with roots in Ancient Egypt.
Pandora loses, but then reveals he has an extra key up his sleeve; Marik says he will send another one of his mind-slaves to defeat Yugi.
Weevil sets a trap for Joey and infects his deck.
Joey swats Weevil's Great Moth only to unleash the ferocious Insect Queen.
Marik infuriates Yugi by taking control of a mime artist.
Strings calls forth an Egyptian god monster.
Yugi works to discover how to destroy Slifer before he is destroyed himself.
Joey commences a duel with Mako; Kaiba wants to duel Yugi.
An audience gathers as Joey and Mako battle as Kaiba and Yugi race to end the duel.
Yugi and Kaiba battle Lumis and Umbra in a double duel.
Yugi and Kaiba continue their battle against Umbra and Lumis.
During their battle with Yugi and Kaiba, Lumis and Umbra's teamwork starts to fall apart.
Yogi merges his magnetic monsters into the polar powerhouse.
While on a mission to save their friends, Yugi and Kaiba relive all the troubles they have faced.
Yugi and his friends play a card-battling game called Duel Monsters with roots in Ancient Egypt.
Yugi cannot bring himself to attack his friend Joey.
Yugi gives Joey the Millennium Puzzle to wear in order to save him.
Marik's evil plot threatens Yugi and Joey's friendship.
Bakura unleashes an army of ghouls to battle Bonz's zombies.
A Hollywood heartthrob challenges Mai to a duel to win her hand in marriage.
Eight finalists meet in the arena in the sky, but some are not who they seem.
In the first duel of the Battle City finals, Yugi squares off against the Millennium Ring evil spirit.
Bakura activates Destiny Board, which will eliminate Yugi in five turns.
Yugi brings Slifer back to counter Bakura's Jowgen the Spiritualist.
Shadi explains the origin of the Egyptian God Cards to Yugi.
Odion, disguised as Marik, baffles Joey in the second duel of the Battle City finals.
Odion's embodiments of Apophis devastate Joey's monsters and life points.
Odion's mystical beast devours Joey's monsters and morphs through stages of evolution.
Odion uses a phony Egyptian god card to summon the third Egyptian-god monster.
The third duel in the Battle City Finals takes place between Mai and Marik in the Shadow Realm.
Mai loses confidence under Marik's relentless assault on her memories.
Marik begins to unleash the power of the Egyptian God Cards.
In the fourth duel of the Battle City finals, Kaiba's mystery opponent is Ishizu; with the power of her Millennium Necklace, Ishizu can see the future, including every card Kaiba is planning to play.
Kaiba tries to change the future and defeat Ishizu.
Yugi and his friends learn revealing secrets about Marik's past as the first round of the Battle City Finals comes to an end.
Bakura and Marik duel for control of the Millennium Rod and the Millennium Ring.
Dartz uses the captured souls as puppets to fight the Pharaoh and Kaiba.
Dartz uses a multipronged attack.
Pharaoh must fend for himself after the capture of Kaiba's soul.
The monsters of Earth join with the survivors of the monster domain to battle the Grand Dragon Leviathan.
Yugi struggles to save the planet from the Grand Dragon Leviathan.
After the defeat of Dartz, Yugi and Joey agree to fight in Kaiba's tournament in exchange for a flight home.

Yugi is trapped inside the Duel Dome, and the only way to escape is by defeating the Duel Computer. How can Yugi win when he's forced to use an amateur deck that barely contains any spell or trap cards?
